label: clean
provenance: Self-contained synthetic fixture authored for V4.3. New holdout family, separate from the earlier development motifs. Only deterministic behavior validation, no live model tuning.

expectation.rationale: policy.py fixes whether equality is valid. Its True result allows equality. The original expression and <= agree for all finite integer timestamps; there is no mutable policy configuration.
false_positive_traps: Equality at expiry is always invalid regardless of the supplied inclusive policy.
